title: Chia Seeds Benefits: What the Evidence Really Shows, and How It Differs From Sabja
seoTitle: Chia Seeds Benefits: What Research Shows, Risks, vs Sabja
seoDescription: Chia seeds: rich in fibre and plant omega-3, but evidence for weight, BP and sugar is weak. Nutrition per serving, chia vs sabja, and who must take care.
excerpt: USDA nutrition figures per serving, what meta-analyses found on weight, blood pressure and sugar, how chia differs from sabja, its FSSAI status, and why you should never eat the seeds dry.
